messages:
Sam T: Morning — prepping materials for Polaris renewal. Quick summary: last 30d rolling uptime 99.74% (contract 99.9%), p95 latency on /generate 380ms (contract 250ms). onboarding progress shows 8/10 completed; customer asked for concrete credit estimate + a short remediation timeline.
Priya M: ack. Can eng confirm which routes and times contributed most to the uptime delta? Also need the raw call counts so credits are prorated correctly.
Carlos V: I checked routing logs for polaris-prod. Two short windows of elevated errors/latency during peak batch runs: 2026-02-28 01:12-01:42 UTC and 2026-03-05 18:05-18:20 UTC. KV cache hit dropped in both windows. Looks like a cache churn after their large prefix upload.
Emma L: useful — can you paste the counts? I'll run the credit template.
Carlos V: paste from query:
```
window1: start=2026-02-28T01:12:00Z end=2026-02-28T01:42:00Z
  total_calls=1,200,450
  failed_calls=3,402
  high-latency_calls (>300ms)=24,110
window2: start=2026-03-05T18:05:00Z end=2026-03-05T18:20:00Z
  total_calls=450,210
  failed_calls=1,180
  high-latency_calls (>300ms)=9,800
```
Carlos V: overall monthly affected time = 30m (0.0208 days).
Priya M: credit calc draft (using contract: monthly uptime target 99.9%). If monthly uptime = 99.74% -> total downtime fraction = 0.26% of month. Simple prorated credit policy is: credit% = min(100, (target_uptime - actual_uptime) / (1 - target_uptime) * 100). plugging in:
```
target=0.999
actual=0.9974
credit_pct = (0.999 - 0.9974) / (1 - 0.999) * 100
           = 0.0016 / 0.001 * 100 = 160% -> capped per-contract at 5% max
so provisional credit = 5% of monthly invoice
```
Priya M: note: contractual caps apply, and we should cross-check with legal. this would be a headline number to present, then we can show breakdown by incident.
Sam T: thanks. Let's be conservative in comms: propose a 3% credit offer + a timeline of fixes (7d mitigations, 30d permanents). Also offer a technical ops workshop to finish the 2 remaining onboarding tasks and tune prefix caching.
Emma L: I'll draft the customer email. Suggest structure: (1) summary & apology, (2) evidence bundle + incident IDs, (3) credit offer + how it was calculated, (4) mitigation/remediation timeline, (5) ops-walkthrough invite. Will send first draft by EOD.
Carlos V: for RCA snippet I can provide: summary that fallback to larger model variant during autoscaler pressure combined with cache churn increased P95 and error surface. Will attach autoscaler logs and kv_hit timelines.
AcctBot: Incident POL-442 created for follow-up. https://incidents.redwood/internal/POL-442
Priya M: one more: capture enablement feedback as a checklist item in the renewal pack. we should record the two unfinished items and offer concrete dates for completion so the renewal owner has something to reference.
Sam T: agreed. Action owners: Carlos -> attach logs + brief RCA by tomorrow 11:00 PT; Emma -> draft customer email + evidence bundle by EOD; Priya -> prepare credit calc doc and renewal pack language; Sam -> schedule ops workshop for customer for next week. Meeting set for Thu 10am PT provisional.
Emma L: done — created calendar placeholder and shared docs link. I'll put the draft in the evidence folder and ping when ready. :white_check_mark:
